name: Camera-Style Case Earbuds — LED Display
description: Wireless earbuds in a camera-shaped charging case with a round LED battery display on the lens. Comes in black, brown/orange and green.

source.notes: Style "Q86", ¥9.30. Rate 223.9 ₦/¥ (listing header). Shop confirmed as Huixun by the style picker. Owner set the price (₦7000). Owner accepts the printed "Sound by KFG / Designed of California" and "Hi-Fi" case; photos keep the print as supplied; copy must not mention KFG or California. PRODUCT-LEVEL ISSUE: "Sound by KFG / Designed of California" and "Hi-Fi" are printed on the case itself, so the physical product carries that third-party-style branding and a "California" origin line. It cannot be cropped or retouched without misrepresenting the product. Hold photos and listing until the owner decides: ask the supplier for a blank-case version, or accept selling the printed case. Photos 800 px square. Overlay not made; copy is ready. Owner sent photos with no message; shop, listing, style name and ¥ price unknown. Likely the Shenzhen Huixun listing (offerId 1025659251706, 58.6% return rate) but unconfirmed: if so, samples first and stay unpublished. Lithium battery: sea freight only. No battery, playtime or waterproofing claimed.
